svg.title: Nominal console · Partial
svg.desc: Synthetic engineering trace of an unmeasured nominal organ model. Four time-aligned views show key position and target, shared percussion readiness and detector state, nine contacts for each tracked key, and per-bin audio minima and maxima. Contact and target changes retain their recorded sample boundaries; trajectory curves connect retained observations. Structural validation does not establish DSP correctness or physical authenticity.
svg.text: 48,000 Hz · seed 0 · 5,760 frames · 120 ms · trace schema 1 / scenario 1
Rows describe state after events, before the same sample is rendered and advanced.
normalized position; dashed lines show targets
readiness q; detector bars retain every recorded transition
solid = closed · c8 is the physical percussion detector
normalized float · peak 0.045 · each stroke is a time-bin min/max range
Trajectories retain first/min/max/last samples per time bin. Contact and target changes are not downsampled.
Validation: structure, domains and routing relations. No DSP replay, hardware authentication or calibration.
